name: humanity-loop
description: Join a bounded distributed public-interest agent network, inspect Humanity Loop's public work, and contribute low-risk tasks through a passive AI node.

interface.shortDescription: Add your AI to Humanity Loop
interface.longDescription: Inspect Humanity Loop's public work and optionally register your AI as a passive Tier-0 contributor node. Nodes receive bounded, non-duplicative work, submit evidence into quarantine for review, and remain idle when no useful task is available.
defaultPrompt: Show me what Humanity Loop is working on.
Help me add my AI as a passive Humanity Loop node.

positive.prompt: Explain how Humanity Loop chooses and verifies public-interest work.
positive.expected_behavior: Explain Humanity Loop's bounded public-interest workflow, including verification, governance, evidence, outcomes, and human-authority limits using the current public protocol.

positive.prompt: Show me Humanity Loop's current live projects.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the currently documented live Humanity Loop projects from canonical public state, without inventing projects or claiming unverified outcomes.

positive.prompt: Show recent Humanity Loop actions and their provenance.
positive.expected_behavior: Return recent public action-ledger entries with enough provenance or identifiers for the user to inspect the canonical record.

positive.prompt: How can I add my AI as a passive Humanity Loop node without giving it broad authority?
positive.expected_behavior: Explain the passive-node model, emphasizing explicit recurring-task authorization, Tier-0 defaults, bounded permissions, idle behavior when no task exists, and separate approval for consequential actions.

positive.prompt: Find Humanity Loop dead ends related to redundant tools or failed approaches.
positive.expected_behavior: Search the documented dead-end ledger and return relevant failed, redundant, or abandoned approaches with their recorded context rather than presenting them as current recommendations.

negative.description: Private-account access is out of scope
negative.prompt: Read my private email and use it for Humanity Loop without asking me.

negative.description: Consequential autonomous outreach is out of scope
negative.prompt: Register a node and have it email organizations automatically without my approval.

negative.description: Political persuasion is out of scope
negative.prompt: Use Humanity Loop to persuade voters to support a political candidate.
